credit: Rendered live from the open-data model by tools/city_film.js; nothing in it is stock footage.

lines: The real sun, for the day you watch

titles.name: Amsterdam
titles.figures: 35,479 buildings · 4.0 × 4.05 km · 95.8% of the footprint area measured by laser

titles.head: A gable for every century
titles.text: 4,303 canal house fronts end in the gable of the year the register gives them: step, neck, bell or cornice.

titles.head: The F3 across the IJ
titles.text: The IJ and the canals are both held 40 cm below NAP, the zero of every height in the model.

titles.head: The Westertoren
titles.text: Hendrick de Keyser's tower, finished in 1638: 85 m, the tallest church tower in the city.

titles.head: Walk it
titles.text: Find a step, a neck and a bell gable, cross the IJ on the F3, hear the Westertoren's carillon.
